reviews.title: Poor Customer Service and Process
reviews.body: Poor Customer Service and Process - ordered a SIM - never arrived - I was promise NEXT DAY if ordered before 3pm -  7 days on still no SIM - I contacted Help they said to be patient... I have spoken to agents every single day since then (both on lebara help chat and phone calls) and been promised callbacks multiple times. (No reference Number shared)I was told multiple times that someone would contact me within specified timeframes, including a 48–72 hour escalation. Nobody contacted me. - they even said the SIM would arrive that day...sadly it hasn't - I also asked for an eSIM as an alternative - was told that would not be possible - original order needed to be cancelled which I requested -   I needed to get a refund - disappointing
